About the model

Model v3.5 · schedule board Sun Oct 25 2:14 PM CT · history through 2026-10-25 · 61,122 maps fitted · 483 teams · 2,463 players · market fit on 9,980 priced series.

Teams: Power is the one number. The model's own price on the Elo scale: 1500 is the average listed team, every 100 points is about 14 percentage points of map win probability against that average. Market-taught power, team Elo, player Elo, plus-minus and Weng-Lin (behind More columns) are inputs or cross-checks, not second opinions.

Players: Perf is the one number. The box-score composite the map probability is built from (kills, deaths inverted, economy-adjusted damage, KAST, opening kills, multikills per round), each in standard deviations against an average tier-1 player over a 100-map half-life. +1.0 is a top-30 player, +1.3 the top 3. Plus-minus (rounds per map above an average player, teammates and opponents controlled) is the team-results check; it cannot separate players who always play together.

Schedule: times Central. Fair = the board's price (50/50 outcome-taught and market-taught; the lower of the two lineup prices when the roster is flagged). Edge = fair minus the price you would pay, in points; eROI = that edge over the price. Kalshi ask figures are after the taker fee; bid+1 figures are for a resting bid one cent above the current bid (no maker fee, fills only if someone sells into it). BET marks a side that meets betting rules v1:

Kalshithe mid of each team's book in cents (bid / ask on hover); ~ = a book wider than 10c

TilesPlaced (dollars, bets, what is still open), Settled P&L (won-lost), ROI on the settled stake, and Win Rate - the share of settled bets won beside the average price paid per bet: a bet at 45c has to win 45% of the time to break even
Combined / Manual / Botthe switch on top: every bet (Combined, the default), your own bets, or the bot's; the tiles, chart, tables and breakdown follow it
Todaythe same tiles for the bets on today's matches (Central)
P&L charteach day's settled P&L as a bar (by the match's start day) and the running total as a line; hover a bar
Table layoutin Start order: open bets first, then settled ones (newest day first), a line for each day, and the bets of one match under one row - tap it to open them. Sort by any other column for the plain list
Bet typethe chip after the team: Series, Map 1 / 2 / 3, the 1.5-map spread (-1.5 = wins 2-0, +1.5 = wins a map) and total maps (Over / Under 2.5); the switch in the toolbar keeps one kind
Breakdownevery table counts your settled bets: Bets, Won (share won, pushes out; the record on hover), Paid (the average price per bet - the win rate it needs to break even), Staked, P&L and ROI. They follow the filters above except Today and Hide completed. A bet whose fills fall in two groups (timing, rounds, price, order type) counts in each; Bet Size groups each bet by its whole stake; the two team tables put each bet under the team you backed and the team you bet against
When You Betagainst bo3.gg's map clock, taken 90 seconds early because it runs behind Kalshi: before the match, between maps, mid-map on the map that market is about, or mid-map on another market (the series, a handicap, the total maps or a later map)
Rounds Playedthe mid-map bets by how many rounds the map in play had finished when the bet filled
Order Typea resting bid of yours that someone sold into, or the ask you took
Start / Bet onthe series' listed start (rows in start order); the team backed - YES on its market and NO on the opponent's are one bet. Tap the teams to open the match in the Matchup tab, the rest of the row for the fill details
Cost / Avg / To windollars at risk, the cost-weighted average price in cents, the payout above the cost
PinnaclePinnacle's devigged price for the side, when it had a line
CLV *Kalshi's last price before the start minus the price paid; for a bet placed in play the pregame close is no benchmark, hence the asterisk
Today / Hide completedonly matches starting today (Central) / only bets still open - both ticked = today's open bets

Guide

Power · Power: the model's strength for this team on an Elo scale - 1500 = the average listed team, +100 = about a 64% map win chance against it. It comes from everything the model uses (the five's ratings, team and map Elo, the box score) and is the number the prices rest on.

Impact · Impact: the five's impact ratings added up - rounds per map over an average lineup. The model's strongest input. Players who always play together share the results credit.

+/- rds · Plus-minus: the five's plain plus-minus added up - rounds per map their teams win above average with them playing. The strongest of the older inputs.

Team Elo · Team Elo: a results-only rating of the team, moved by every map it plays (1500 = average). The model's team-level input; weaker than the box-based ratings on its own.

Δwk / Δmo · How Power moved over the last 7 / 30 days (vs the snapshots of 2026-10-18 / 2026-09-25). Form and slumps, not a predictor.

Maps 180d · Maps in the last 180 days - the evidence behind the numbers (under 30 is thin).

Last / Next · The team's last map; its next scheduled series and the model's chance in it.

Extra columns · Mkt power = the same strength from the market-taught version of the model (fitted to Pinnacle's closes instead of results); the live fair blends the two 50/50 Maps 365d = maps in the last year. Lineup = the five the strength is priced on: the listed roster when it has five, else the last five who played.

Colours · Power only (the number the prices rest on): green = the top 10% of the teams shown, deeper toward the best; red = the bottom 10%. Ranks are among the rows on screen, so a filter re-shades them.

Rows · tap a team's row for its five with their Impact, +/- rds and Perf; tap the name for the team card; tap a player anywhere for his card.

Guide

Impact · Impact, our rating: rounds per map a player adds over an average one - his box score (adjusted for opponents and tier) corrected by his teams' results. Predicts results better than any public rating; the model prices with it. Players who always play together share the results credit.

+/- rds · Plus-minus: rounds per map his teams win above average with him playing, teammates and opponents accounted for. The strongest of the older stats; Impact builds on it.

Perf · His box score in one number - kills, deaths, damage, KAST, opening kills, multi-kills - vs an average tier-1 player (0 = average; a typical tier-1 starter about +0.5). No team effects: sort by it for the box score alone.

Δwk / Δmo · How Perf moved over the last 7 / 30 days (vs the snapshots of 2026-10-18 / 2026-09-25). Form and slumps; not a predictor, so not in the rating.

Maps 365d · Maps in the last year: the evidence behind his numbers (under 30 is thin); experience counts too - a newcomer starts about 1.4 rounds below a 100-map player with the same box score.

Last · His last map; away a year = his box history faded by half.

Extra columns · Career maps = since 2020. KPR / DPR = kills / deaths per round; ADR/econ = damage per round, discounted against poorly equipped enemies; KAST = share of rounds with a kill, an assist, a survival or a traded death; OPK = opening kills minus opening deaths; MK = multi-kill rounds; Clutch = clutches won; Util = utility used. All tier- and opponent-adjusted, in standard deviations (0 = average): what Impact and Perf are made of - deaths and damage weigh most, KAST is the best single stat, Clutch and Util add nothing.

Colours · green = the top 10% of the players shown in that column, deeper toward the best; red = the bottom 10%; DPR reversed. Ranks are among the rows on screen.

* · not on a current roster (team = his last team).

Column guide
Colourseach team is drawn in its own colour, read from its logo and darkened or lightened until it can be read on the page - its name, its pick and ban tags, its Elo line, the maps it won in the head to head. A team with a black and white logo is drawn in dark grey. When the two colours are too close to tell apart (two reds, a yellow and a gold) one team takes its second colour or the grey; two black and white logos get the page's blue and orange
Avg Rkthe two teams' average Power rank (lower = better teams; hover for both ranks). Amber with a hollow amber star = suggested to star: neither team is on the blocklist and either the average is the suggest_star_max_avg_rank cutoff or better or Pinnacle prices the series - also when Kalshi has not listed it yet, since a star carries to the bot once it does. A filled blue star = starred by rule: the average is auto_star_max_avg_rank (75) or better and neither team is blocklisted, so the bot bets it as soon as it is on the board; tap it to un-star that series for good
Matchesthe day's series, one line each (map markets folded in): time and tier, the teams, the model's and Pinnacle's chances (first team first), BET when the bot's rules bet a side; a finished series shows its score. Top Tiers Only keeps tiers 1 and 2. Click a row to explore it. The star keeps a series on your Starred list - any day, any tier; saved in this browser, so your phone and laptop each keep their own; a series drops off three days after its start.
Win chancefor the first team: the board's model fair, Pinnacle devigged (from = its opening line), Kalshi bid / ask and Edge (model minus Kalshi's mid, cents) for the series and each map market; for two teams not on the board, the model's map / Bo3 / Bo5 chance from their Power ratings
Mapspick maps 1-3 (or click a map in the list) to see the map and series chances move: each map's chance is the board's own map price (for a match not on the board, the Power map chance) shifted by the two teams' map Elo offsets (a model component), and 'any' uses the unshifted price, so with no maps set the series chance is the board's; when a team's listed roster differs from the five who played last, Last five / Roster five switches between the board's two prices (it starts on the one behind the first team's fair; each side's fair takes the lower, so in the list above the two can add up to less than 100, marked *); The list is a scoreboard: the series first (each team's chance to win it now, the maps won under each logo), then one row for each map of the series in play order (M1, M2, M3), then the maps left in the pool. Click a pool map to put it in the next free slot, click a set map's row to take it out. Likely fills each team's most-picked map (not the other's top ban) and the likeliest decider; map 1 is the pick of the team expected to pick first - the underdog, because the better-seeded team chooses its place in the veto and nearly always takes the second pick (in top-tier series since 2025 the underdog picked map 1 about three times in four, nine in ten against a 70%+ favourite); in a close match the team listed second. Each map's row says whose pick it is, and Swap puts the other team first. In a Bo3 maps 1 and 2 are the two picks, and a pick counts: the team that picked a map wins it about 3 points more often than the map's own chance says (4 while the map is not chosen yet), so that much is added for the picker and taken from the other team - the series chance does not move. The numbers for maps 1 and 2 already include it, before any map is chosen too. Results count too: once a map has a winner, the maps still to play move with it - a team that has lost a map is priced lower on the next one than before the match (about 6 points for a 60% team), one that has won a map higher (about 4), because a result says something about the day that the pre-match numbers did not know; the team that lost map 1 used to be shown about 2 to 3 points too high for the series. To enter a result, click the logo of the team that won the map, or type the rounds in the small box beside each logo: 13 marks that team's win by itself (a finished overtime score such as 16-14 too); the two teams then show W and L on that map and the maps won count up in the series row. With both teams' rounds in the boxes the score is used too: a narrow loss moves the next maps about a point less than an average one, a one-sided loss about two points more. Rounds that are not a final score change nothing - the tab cannot price a map that is being played. What you set on this card - maps, results, who picks first, the format, the price you typed - is remembered for each pair of teams in this browser for a few days, so you can switch between matchups and come back to them. The list shows each team's win rate and maps played in the last 180 days, and tags each team's most-picked map (a filled tag in the team's colour) and its most-banned map (an outlined one). The Handicap row under the series gives each team's -1.5 (wins by two maps or more: 2-0 in a Bo3, 3-0 or 3-1 in a Bo5) and +1.5 (wins, or loses by one map) with the chance of each final score beside them; they move with the maps decided. Kalshi's 'wins by over 1.5 maps' market is that team's -1.5, and its No side is the other team's +1.5. The Price check takes those lines too (-1.5 maps / +1.5 maps in its menu). A MAP BEING PLAYED: type the score as it stands in the first undecided map's boxes (7 and 5) - a score that is not final marks the map as live (its slot label turns red), and its row then shows each team's chance to win the map from that score: the rounds as a chain from the map's own chance before it started, the CT and T sides (click who is on CT now; the sides swap by themselves at halftime and in overtime) and who won the last round and the half's pistol (read from how the score moved: leave each new score in the boxes with Enter or a tap away), calibrated on 45,000 maps; the series, the handicap and the Price check follow it. Keep in mind what the data says about betting during a map: Kalshi prices a round a minute or two before a stream shows it, our past mid-map bets lost 34% while bets made before a map started won, and a gap of under about 10 points mid-map is not an edge.
Elo, last 6 monthsteam Elo from map results at the end of every week - the model's own team Elo, replayed; the logos mark whose line is whose
Comparisonunder Win chance: Power, the last 10 series, maps won and maps won above the Elo expectation in the last 90 days, the five's impact ratings added up (the better number bold)
Lineupsthe current five: Maps = maps played for this team (everything our data holds, since June 2020; amber under 20 = new to the team), then the stats from left to right in order of how predictive they are, sorted by Impact: Impact (our own rating - rounds per map a player adds, from his opponent-adjusted box score and his teams' results; the model's main input since 3.0), Perf (our box-score composite in standard deviations; a typical tier-1 player is about +0.5), K/D, the bo3.gg rating (0-10; maps bo3.gg had not rated when we fetched them are left out), ADR and form (last 10 maps vs the 90-day average; ADR and form not on a phone). Shaded like the Players tab: green = top 10% of the top-600 players (deeper toward the best), red = bottom 10%.
Head to headat the bottom: the record in the last 12 months and the last five meetings (month/day/year) with map scores
